scene_delta.title: Chic Navy Studio Portrait
scene_delta.pose: Waist-up composition, standing naturally beside a minimalist studio chair, body angled slightly while facing the camera directly.
scene_delta.expression: Calm, professional, and serene expression with a subtle, natural gaze.
scene_delta.outfit: Tailored fine dark navy blazer over a clean ivory inner top, professional and polished.
scene_delta.camera: High-resolution studio camera, waist-up framing, sharp focus on the subject.
scene_delta.lens: 85mm f/1.8 portrait lens, creating a soft, blurred background.
scene_delta.lighting: Softbox studio lighting, even illumination with gentle highlights on the skin, clean and professional atmosphere.
scene_delta.location: Minimalist professional photo studio with a neutral, clean background.
scene_delta.action: Posing calmly for a professional portfolio photograph, looking directly into the lens.
scene_delta.styling: Neat and polished, long straight dark hair styled smoothly, subtle professional makeup.
scene_delta.negative_constraints: No extra people, no exaggerated body proportions, no messy hair, no casual or sloppy clothing, no heavy jewelry, no distorted anatomy.
